narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional street interview for foodpanda. It uses humor and real-life testimonials from delivery riders—highlighting unique customer interactions and high earning potential—to humanize the brand and encourage viewers to sign up as delivery partners.
